BROLLYVISION
TX-100

Try 101 (top stories), 120, 140, 200, 300, 700 (new adverts each UK day) and 800 (art lab). Pages marked (s) are invented samples. Keyboard: 0-9, R G Y C, up/down arrows, space to hold, backspace to clear. The clock shows UK time, matching the feed. Typeface: Bedstead by Ben Harris.







  
REMEMBER CEEFAX?

  
Remember the days before social media and the internet? You'd check Ceefax, see that the Berlin Wall had opened, and think, "I should catch that on the Nine O'Clock News."

  
Well, now you can hark back to that time with an updated Teletext TV.

  
No scrolling, no links, no notifications. Just a three-digit number and a short wait while the page arrives.

  

  
Press the red key to start.
